pages.text: The first snow fell softly. The three sat on the bench by the stove. The door opened, and a baby squirrel, smaller than all three, came in. "Hello!" Nono, the smallest, roundest sparrow, hopped in greeting.
Kiki, the pointy-eared cat, fiddled with the green bell. Kiki wanted to join, but no "hello" came out.
Nono and Gugu, the broad-chested pigeon, laughed with the squirrel. Kiki sat alone at the bench end, ears flattening back, toes wriggling below.
Kiki glanced at the squirrel. Their eyes met! Kiki quickly pretended to watch the first snow outside.
Nono patted the seat beside him. "Hello! Sit beside me!" The squirrel scurried over and settled there.
There was an empty seat beside Kiki too. Kiki wanted to pat it, but the mouth and hands seemed frozen.
The squirrel smiled at the snow beside Nono. Kiki's seat stayed empty. Kiki's eyes stung, and the nose turned red.
Grandpa added a stick of wood to the stove. "When I first came to this alley, I did not know anyone either. So I said hello first."
Kiki stood tall. "One, look at their eyes! Two, smile! Three, hello! Sit beside me!" Kiki patted the empty seat.
The squirrel scurried over and snuggled beside Kiki. Say hello first, and your next seat need not stay empty. Kiki touched the green bell. "Hello! Sit beside me!"
